messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened a small PR to tidy examples around tool-calling + structured output. Main fixes: sanitize user-provided tool names, show parse fallback, and add JS/py SDK snippets for the new schema helpers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :sparkles:

alex: skimmed — looks good. Can you also add a short note about nullable arrays? We hit a parsing mismatch in the recommender eval when tools returned [null] vs [] last week.

samir: I can add a python snippet using the rwinf SDK. For sanitization we should show both whitelist and a small slugify fallback. Proposed JS example:

```js
// sanitize tool name before calling
const safeTool = (name, allowed) => allowed.includes(name) ? name : slugify(name).replace(/[^a-z0-9-_]/g, '');
await client.callTool({tool: safeTool(userInput), args});
```

And a short python helper:

```py
def safe_tool(name, allowed):
    if name in allowed:
        return name
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-_]", "", slugify(name).lower())
```

ellen: heads-up — when you add examples, include a line about attaching the trace id to tool calls (we log it in observability). Also add the minimal KMS note for private deployments. Otherwise SRE fine.

maria: thanks — pushed updates: added JS/Python, added a compact JSON Schema showing nullable arrays and a fallback parser example. Also fixed two stale links (tooling -> /sdk/tooling and evals -> /dev/evals). New snippet for schema (compact):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
    "targets": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"type": "string"}}
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

alex: nit: move the "parse fallback" paragraph higher (readers hit that first) and add a test instruction: run `make docs-test` then `pytest tests/parsing`. Also maybe include a failing example and the fixed output.

samir: pushed another commit replacing slugify+regex with `safeName` util from rwinf-sdk (keeps examples consistent). Added unit test file: `tests/test_tool_name_sanitizer.py` with cases for `None`, "My Tool!", ["null"] etc.

ellen: approved from SRE side — KMS note and trace id example look good. :thumbsup:

patchbot: deploy check: CI failed on docs lint (link-check) — broken link to /sdk/old-tooling.

maria: fixed the link, removed the old anchor. Also wrote a short migration note: "old tool schema -> use tool_envelope v2" so searchers find it.

patchbot: CI passed on latest commit. All checks green.

maria: merging after CI green. Follow-up issue to add a runnable playground example for the envelope + sanitizer (will link from PR). Thanks everyone for quick reviews. :rocket:

alex: thanks — will add the eval checklist item to the migration doc later.

samir: noted, will coordinate to add a small raw-to-envelope converter in the SDK next sprint.

ellen: thanks, good to see the parsing flakiness doc updated.

maria: closing thread once PR is merged.

patchbot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 (commits: 6)
